metadata.name: light-casino
metadata.description: Generated by pinocchio-idl from programs/light-casino/src. Instruction discriminators are sha256("global:<name>")[..8], matching dispatch.rs. pinocchio-idl's id is a single byte, so generate.py restores those sighashes.

instructions.name: initialize_game
docs: Initialize a new game.
Creates a `GameState` PDA to track game progress. Config is copied from
the room table (`game_kind` / `shoe_decks` / `roulette_variant`).

instructions.name: set_bingo_pattern
docs: Announce the 75-ball public pattern (0=any line, 1=corners, 2=blackout).
Must land after registration and before the first share chunk is verified.

instructions.name: extend_share_chunks
docs: Open the next blackjack / bingo share chunk after a prefix finalize.
Clears `shared_mask` and returns to Share so seats can verify chunk N+1
while already-shared cards remain revealable on poker (`shared_cards`).

instructions.name: init_cpi_authority
docs: Initialize the empty `cpi_authority` PDA used to sign poker `consume_*` CPIs.

instructions.name: close_cpi_authority
docs: Close the program-owned `cpi_authority` stub (any 8-byte init layout).
After close, clients fund the same PDA as a system account so it can pay
rent when CPIing `poker::consume_register_receipt`.

instructions.name: store_artifact_chunk
docs: Persist one artifact chunk (shuffle deck / share active limbs / showdown
encrypted masks) to Light. Address seeds: `artifact` || game_id || kind || owner || chunk.

instructions.name: register_player
docs: Register a player.
Verifies a `register_main` Groth16 proof (6 public inputs).
The public inputs are: [publicKey_x, publicKey_y, padding_0, padding_1, padding_2, padding_3].
Creates a `PlayerState` PDA and a `RegisterCompressedAccount` via Light Protocol CPI.

instructions.name: extend_deck_state
docs: Grow `deck_state` by up to 10 KiB toward this table's shoe.

instructions.name: close_deck_state
docs: Return shoe-sized deck_state rent to the game operator after evaluation.

instructions.name: allocate_shuffle_public_inputs
docs: Allocate shuffle public-inputs PDA (≤10 KiB). Call `extend_shuffle_public_inputs`
until full size, then `create_shuffle_public_inputs` to write the header.

instructions.name: extend_shuffle_public_inputs
docs: Grow shuffle public-inputs PDA by up to 10 KiB toward full size.

instructions.name: prepare_shuffle_chunk
docs: Fold one disjoint MSM slice of caller-staged public inputs into a partial G1.
`start` must be a multiple of [`PREPARE_INPUTS_PER_TX`]. Chunks may land in
any order. Does **not** re-derive the transient commitment (finalize does).

instructions.name: finalize_prepare_shuffle_inputs
docs: Sum MSM partials into `prepared_g1`, then fold the transient input commitment.
Remaining accounts are the canonical player PDAs in seat order.

instructions.name: verify_shuffle_staged
docs: Verify staged shuffle Groth16 proof, register `permutationHash` globally
via Light address uniqueness (`used_perm` || hash), then CPI-consume.
Remaining accounts: Light CPI accounts only. Player PDAs are consumed by
Preparation has already folded the locally derived transient commitment.

instructions.name: finalize_shuffle
docs: Consume the output-only shuffle receipt and advance.

instructions.name: verify_share

accounts.name: proof_receipt
docs: Share receipt keyed by Arcis `share_verify_acc.generation` (see `init_share_receipt`).
PDA seeds are checked in the instruction against that generation.
Verify share partials proof.
Uses `share_hashout_main` (2 public inputs).
Verifier inputs are [caller output, locally derived transient commitment].
The verifier derives the second public signal from canonical deck and player
accounts. The caller supplies only the proof and output digest.
Players may submit in any order / in parallel. Progress is tracked via
`shared_mask` (who has shared), not `current_player`.
Blackjack: `chunk_index` selects the 16-card window; a seat is marked
shared only after all `n_share_chunks` chunk proofs succeed.
Non-blackjack: pass `chunk_index = 0`.
Remaining accounts: player PDAs `0..num_players-1`.

instructions.name: verify_slot_share
docs: Slots share: Groth16 nPublic=10 (`outHash` + 8 coin-bet limbs + derived).
Remaining accounts: player PDAs `0..num_players-1`.

instructions.name: verify_bet
docs: Verify staged split-game bet proof and record `RouletteBetCommitment`.
Remaining accounts: player PDAs in seat order (for HashPublicKeys(2)).
Roulette / craps / keno: every seat (including the house) must already
be registered (phase is Shuffle or Share). Betting closes at Evaluation,
before Arcis reveal / showdown.

instructions.name: verify_card_commit
docs: PvP bingo card commit (not a bet). Sealed only to the prover.
Window: after all seats register, before the first share chunk is verified.
Remaining accounts: player PDAs in seat order (prover key only is hashed).

instructions.name: close_bet_public_inputs
docs: Store the verified bet hash as a Light compressed account and refund the bet_inputs staging PDA.

instructions.name: allocate_share_public_inputs
docs: Allocate roulette share staging PDA (≤10 KiB). Call `extend_share_public_inputs`
until full size, then `create_share_public_inputs` to write the header.

instructions.name: extend_share_public_inputs
docs: Grow roulette share staging PDA by up to 10 KiB toward full size.

instructions.name: create_share_public_inputs
docs: Write header into a fully allocated roulette share staging PDA (nPublic=579).

instructions.name: prepare_share_inputs
docs: Legacy sequential MSM fold into `prepared_g1`. Prefer
[`prepare_share_chunk`] + [`finalize_prepare_share_inputs`].
Incompatible with the parallel path once any prepare chunk has landed
(`prepare_started`).

instructions.name: prepare_share_chunk
docs: Fold one disjoint MSM slice of staged share publics into a partial G1.
`start` must be a multiple of [`share_staging::PREPARE_INPUTS_PER_TX`].
Chunks may land in any order.

instructions.name: finalize_prepare_share_inputs
docs: Sum MSM partials into `prepared_g1` and mark prepare complete.

instructions.name: verify_share_staged

accounts.name: proof_receipt
docs: Share receipt keyed by Arcis `share_verify_acc.generation` (see `init_share_receipt`).
PDA seeds are checked in the instruction against that generation.
Verify roulette share with staged nPublic=579 inputs.
Same Arcis binding as [`verify_share`]: `share_verify_acc` must be frozen
and `verify_expected` must equal Groth16 `outHash`. Dealer shares must
have `actualBetCount == 0`. Records bet commitment for Light persistence
(see [`store_roulette_bets`]); staging stays open until bets are stored.

instructions.name: store_roulette_bets
docs: Persist roulette encrypted bet limbs into Light compressed artifact chunks
(`LIGHT_KIND_ROULETTE_BETS`). Must run after [`verify_share_staged`] while
share staging still holds the 576 bet fields. Closes staging when done.

instructions.name: init_shuffle_receipt
docs: Allocate the shuffle receipt separately so the proof + Light validity
proof transaction does not exceed Solana's packet-size limit.

instructions.name: init_share_receipt
docs: Allocate the share receipt before the hash-heavy Groth16 transaction.

instructions.name: init_showdown_receipt
docs: Allocate the showdown proof receipt separately so the hash-heavy verify
transaction does not also carry Anchor's account-init heap overhead.

instructions.name: verify_showdown_receipt

accounts.name: showdown_material
docs: recipient, and `complete` are verified in `verify_showdown_receipt`.

accounts.name: sealed_showdown_coefficients
docs: PDA seed, non-zero immutable commitment, and layout are verified above.

accounts.name: roulette_bet_commitment
docs: Roulette only: bet commitment PDA (`roulette_bets` || game || player).

accounts.name: blackjack_showdown_layout
docs: Blackjack only: action-derived showdown layout PDA.

accounts.name: bingo_showdown_rows
docs: Bingo only: staged ciphertext-row hashes.

accounts.name: keno_showdown_rows
docs: Keno only: staged share-row hashes. Closed into the rent vault after a valid proof.
Verify showdown Groth16 proof against the on-chain Poseidon input hash.
Does not advance phase or CPI-consume — call `finalize_showdown` next.
Remaining accounts are canonical Light player PDAs followed by
recipient-major, card-index ordered poker `RevealedCard` PDAs. They
contain Arcis-resealed ciphertext limbs, which Light hashes with the
Circom Poseidon layout; Arcis is not a showdown-row hash oracle.

instructions.name: finalize_showdown
docs: Join showdown Groth16 receipt + Poseidon input hash, then CPI into poker.

instructions.name: verify_showdown
docs: Verify decrypt/compare hands proof.
Uses `showdown_hashout_main` (2 public inputs).
Verifier inputs are [caller output, locally derived transient commitment].
Any seated player may submit; one proof completes the hand.
Authenticated MPC materials are required before showdown verification.
(Light remaining accounts are consumed by the CPI helper; pass hash accounts
ahead of Light accounts by putting them in the typed context where possible.
Here deck_state is typed; player + partials are in `remaining_accounts` before
any Light accounts the client appends for the compressed-account CPI.)

instructions.name: fold

accounts.name: proof_receipt
docs: Share receipt keyed by Arcis `share_verify_acc.generation` (see `init_share_receipt`).
PDA seeds are checked in the instruction against that generation.
Fold a poker player.
Equivalent to `verify_share` followed by clearing the player's
`pot_mask` bit. Poker only — other games have no pot mask.

instructions.name: record_blackjack_showdown_layout
docs: Record the action-derived player/dealer card layout for blackjack showdown.
Must run after hit/split/stay resolves a non-bust hand (bust skips showdown).

instructions.name: record_blackjack_insurance

accounts.name: initial_action_layout
docs: Initial (seq 0) player action layout — proves pre-action 2-card window.

accounts.name: dealer_action_layout
docs: Dealer seq-0 action layout — Ace-up comes from verified circuit output.
Record an insurance / even-money decision.
Allowed only while the hand is still in share/evaluation (pre-showdown).
Ace-up is read from the verified dealer action layout (circuit output),
not a free caller claim. Call once after the initial deal action proofs
and before hole reveal / further player actions.

instructions.name: init_action_receipt
docs: Allocate blackjack action proof receipt.

instructions.name: verify_action
docs: Verify blackjack mid-hand action hashout proof.
Public signals: `[output_hash, derived_input_hash]`.
`insurance_eligible` is a hashed input constrained to the dealer upcard being an Ace.
Dealer status 2 inside the polynomial is a natural blackjack.

instructions.name: open_showdown_window
docs: Open the three-minute showdown-proof window.
Share completion already opens it for every game except blackjack and bingo.

instructions.name: open_blackjack_action_window
docs: Start the three-minute clock for a blackjack seat that still has to act.

instructions.name: stand_blackjack_seat
docs: Stand a blackjack seat. The seat may leave immediately. The dealer may stand them after three minutes without an action.

instructions.name: forfeit_showdown
docs: Close an unproven showdown as a player loss.
The house dealer, or the game operator when there is no house seat, may call this three minutes after the showdown window opened.

errors.name: InputHashMismatch
errors.msg: Poseidon input hash does not match on-chain state

errors.name: InvalidChunkCount
errors.msg: Revealed partial chunk count must be between 1 and 8

errors.name: InvalidAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the registered player authority

errors.name: CasinoBridgeRequired
errors.msg: Casino bridge required for this game

errors.name: ShowdownMaterialsNotVerified
errors.msg: Authenticated MPC showdown materials are not verified

errors.name: ShowdownCoefficientCommitmentMissing
errors.msg: Showdown coefficient commitment is missing or invalid

errors.name: InvalidStagingWrite
errors.msg: Staging writes must be contiguous from the current offset

errors.name: InvalidGameConfig
errors.msg: Invalid game kind / shoe / roulette variant combination

errors.name: DealerMustHaveZeroBets
errors.msg: House/dealer cannot submit a bet proof

errors.name: RouletteBetsNotStored
errors.msg: Roulette bets must be stored to Light before showdown

errors.name: BlackjackLayoutNotRecorded
errors.msg: Blackjack showdown layout must be recorded before showdown

errors.name: BlackjackInsuranceNotOffered
errors.msg: Blackjack insurance requires a dealer Ace upcard

errors.name: BlackjackInsuranceWindowClosed
errors.msg: Blackjack insurance window is closed (need initial 2-card action)

types.name: ArtifactChunkCompressedAccount
docs: Shuffle / share / showdown chunk: up to 8 BE field commitments.
Address seeds carry `(kind, owner_index, chunk_index)`.

types.name: RegisterCompressedAccount
docs: Register artifact: ElGamal public key + padding ciphertext coords.

types.name: UsedPermutationCompressedAccount
docs: Global used-permutation leaf: one Light address per `permutationHash`.
Address seeds: `used_perm` || permutation_hash (not per-game).
